entities.name: Shigeki
entities.description: Orochi druid enchantment creature, founder and leader of the Order of Jukai in Kamigawa.

entities.name: Order of Jukai
entities.description: Group founded by Shigeki after prophetic visions, favoring destructive action against technological innovation.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where the Order of Jukai operates.

events.summary: Shigeki, communing with a nature kami, had a prophetic vision of the spirit realm shattering and founded the Order of Jukai.
events.quote: Shigeki, communing with a powerful nature kami , experienced a prophetic vision of the spirit realm shattering

relations.quote: Shigeki is a orochi druid enchantment creature and leader of the Order of Jukai in Kamigawa
Aided by a mysterious kami that refers to itself simply as " Mori "
